notes.title: 🔥 BODYCOMBAT 100 DLC is OUT NOW 🔥
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="mqhqnMmqksQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The wait is over — [i]BODYCOMBAT 100 DLC[/i] has officially launched on Steam! 🥊[/p][p]Last year, as part of the [b]25th anniversary of Les Mills[/b] we released this DLC on Meta Quest, and it is now available on Steam![/p][p]BODYCOMBAT 100 takes your VR training to the next level with brand-new workouts, music, mechanics, and more. Whether you’re a seasoned fighter or just starting your journey, BODYCOMBAT 100 is the ultimate way to celebrate this milestone.[/p][p][/p][h2]🆕 What’s new in BODYCOMBAT 100[/h2][p]💪 [b]8 new workouts[/b]
Train harder with fresh routines — including one adapted directly from the legendary BODYCOMBAT 100 program. Plus, 25 new songs to fuel every strike.[/p][p]💯 [b]Fresh gameplay mechanics[/b]
Step up to the [i]100 Hustle[/i] and challenge yourself with the [i]100 Hit Challenge[/i] — precision, focus, and endurance required.[/p][p]🪙 [b]New environment[/b]
Fight inside our first-ever indoor arena: the BODYCOMBAT Hall of Fame, honoring 25 years of BODYCOMBAT history.[/p][p]🥊 [b]Premium cosmetics[/b]
Equip exclusive [i]BODYCOMBAT 100 gloves[/i] and dominate from a brand-new platform.[/p][p][/p][h2]💥 Ready to fight?[/h2][p]Download the DLC today and take on the ultimate BODYCOMBAT challenge. Get BODYCOMBAT 100 with a launch discount during the first week![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535940/LES_MILLS_BODYCOMBAT_BODYCOMBAT_100/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix v 1.2.0
notes.notes: [p]We’re bringing you an update with improvements and fixes to make your workouts smoother and more enjoyable: [/p][list][*][p]Offline Mode: Sessions in offline mode now appear correctly.,[/p][/*][*][p]DLCs: Fixed an issue that prevented cosmetics from DLCs purchased outside the game from showing up properly.,[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite Loading Screen: We’ve addressed a recurring issue that caused infinite loading screens for many users. While we can’t guarantee it’s 100% resolved for everyone, our tests indicate it should no longer occur.,[/p][/*][*][p]Several visual bugs have been fixed to improve the overall look of the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]UI Adjustments: Fixes to the menu, including the button to open/close dojos.,[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual improvements for a more polished experience.[/p][/*][/list]
